items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Keith Jarrett, yeah. He’d hold up a sign, “Keith Jarrett.”

ctx.x: Keith Jarrett, yeah. He’d hold up a sign, “Keith Jarrett.” And the audience is going wow. That’s show biz. So I went to see people, and now, I’m not saying that any student should come to see me. That’s not what I’m saying. But I have done gigs in clubs where the last set is a jam session. Not for me. When I’m done then they bring a different rhythm section up and it’s a jam session. In come all the students. Why weren’t you here to catch whatever was happening first?
